title: cmux ext new --kind: a new extension loads, a saved edit reloads in well under a second

steps.title: New: cmux ext new hello --kind sidebar, then cmux ext dev loads it into this cmux
cmux: clear; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd "$(mktemp -d)" && cmux ext new hello --kind sidebar && cd hello && ls && (cmux ext dev --no-install & echo $! > .dev.pid)

steps.title: Edit: save src/main.ts with Hello changed to Edited; cmux ext dev prints the reload time
Reloaded: cmux ext shot outlines what the reloaded section draws (the edit)
cmux: kill "$(cat .dev.pid)"; sleep 0.5; cmux ext shot --out /dev/null 2>&1 | head -12

steps.title: Session Info too: cmux ext new info --kind session-info loads as written
cmux: clear; cd .. && cmux ext new info --kind session-info && cd info && cmux ext shot --out /dev/null 2>&1 | head -12

steps.title: A pane too: cmux ext new board --kind pane loads as written
cmux: clear; cd .. && cmux ext new board --kind pane && cd board && cmux ext shot --out /dev/null 2>&1 | head -12; cmux ext new tab --kind menu
